entities.summary: Charles John Olson was a second generation modernist American poet who was a link between earlier modernist figures such as Ezra Pound and William Carlos Williams and the third generation modernist New American poets. The latter includes the New York School, the Black Mountain School, and some of the artists and poets associated with the Beat generation and the San Francisco Renaissance. Charles Olson was a writers & intellectuals from Worcester (1910-12-27, Worcester–1970-01-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
